page: Microsoft Azure M128-64bds_v3 is a memory-optimized server belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8473C x86_64 processor featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs across 32 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The system is configured with 105 MB of L3 cache, 1024.0 GB of RAM providing 16.0 GB per core, and a 410 GB local SSD. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and supports Premium Storage configurations.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core scores placing in the top 25% of tested systems. The memory subsystem is highly competitive, achieving a large-block read-only memory bandwidth of 366.27 GB/sec, which ranks in the top 10% tier. Database operations are a primary strength, with Passmark database benchmarks also scoring in the top 10% tier. The processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions, which assist in workloads like LLM inference, where prompt processing for a medium 7B model achieves 230.48 tokens/sec.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this server offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound enterprise workloads rather than compute-only tasks. The lack of a GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training, but the combination of massive memory, local SSD storage, and high database transaction performance makes it highly suitable for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, and enterprise data processing pipelines.
